job.job_description:
Role: Python Developer (Azure & Databricks)

Experience: 815 Years

Location: Indore / Pune / Bangalore

Work Timing: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST

Work Mode: 5 Days Work From Office




Job Summary




We are looking for an experienced Python Developer with strong expertise in Python, Django, Azure, and Databricks to build scalable, cloud-native applications and data processing solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in backend development, API development, distributed data processing, and Azure cloud services. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop secure, high-performance applications and data pipelines while following best engineering practices.




Mandatory Skills (One Line)




Python, Django, Azure, Azure Databricks, PySpark, REST APIs, SQL, Azure Data Lake, Git, Microservices.




Roles & Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Python and Django.

Build and optimize data processing solutions using Azure Databricks and PySpark.

Develop RESTful APIs and integrate applications with enterprise systems and third-party services.

Work with Azure services such as Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Monitor.

Develop and optimize ETL/data transformation pipelines for large-scale datasets.

Write efficient SQL queries and work with relational and NoSQL databases.

Collaborate with Data Engineers, Architects, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

Optimize application performance, scalability, and security following industry best practices.

Participate in code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and production support activities.

Maintain technical documentation and ensure adherence to coding standards and Agile development practices.

Work closely with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, automation, and cloud-native application development.
